sentences.en: Sean, I just want to say, as right as we start at the top of the show, I just want to say this is our 52nd episode of SmartLess.

So, yeah, let's get to it.

sentences.zh: 我不知道你们有没有意识到，这是我们的第52期节目，也就是说我们已经走过了一年。
自从我们开始胡闹以来。

sentences.en: Remember when we first started talking about doing this?
sentences.zh: 还记得我们刚开始商量要做这个的时候吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I thought it was really just going to be three, four, five weeks, maybe something like that.
sentences.zh: 对，我当时以为也就做三、四周、五周这样子吧。

sentences.en: And then COVID would be over and we'd be back to our day jobs.
sentences.zh: 然后疫情就会结束，我们就能回去干正事了。

sentences.en: But, God, thank you, everyone, for listening.
sentences.zh: 但是，天哪，谢谢大家收听。

sentences.en: And letting Will, Sean, and I continue to visit with one another every week, keeping our friendship alive.
sentences.zh: 还有让威尔、肖恩和我每周都能聚在一起，维持了我们的友谊。

sentences.en: For me, it really, spending this last year with you guys in this way, even more than normal, has been a really great sort of antidote to an otherwise not amazing year.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，过去这一年以这种方式和你们在一起，甚至超过了平常，真的是对抗这个本不精彩的一年的绝佳解药。

sentences.en: And being able to hang out with you guys has been fucking a real savior, to me, anyway, for my mental health.
sentences.zh: 能和你们鬼混他妈的真成了我的救命稻草，对我而言，至少对我的心理健康来说是这样。

sentences.en: It's been a nice thing to be able to count on once a week.
sentences.zh: 能每周都有个盼头，这感觉真好。

sentences.en: I feel so lucky to be even closer to you guys and have this experience, to echo what Will said, together.
sentences.zh: 能和你们更亲近并拥有这段经历，呼应威尔刚才的话，我感到非常幸运。

sentences.en: And the opportunity to laugh together, which to me is life.
sentences.zh: 还有一起欢笑的机会，对我来说这就是生活。

sentences.en: And it's not just the three of us.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是我们三个人。
显然，还有我们的整个团队。

sentences.en: And the other part of that team is Bennett Barberkow and Rob Arm-Yarv and Michael Terry.
sentences.zh: 团队的另一部分是班奈特·巴伯考、罗布·阿姆亚尔夫和迈克尔·特里。

sentences.en: But we always know that Rob's name is always Rob Arm-Yarv.
sentences.zh: 但我们一直都知道罗布的名字其实念作罗布·阿姆亚尔夫。

sentences.en: Is that how you say it, Sean?
Yeah, I like to say it the phonetic way.
sentences.zh: 对，我喜欢按拼读法来念。
嗯，这就是它的拼写方式。
所以不用念成阿姆亚尔夫。

sentences.en: Because even he doesn't know how you're supposed to say it.
sentences.zh: 因为连他自己都不知道到底该怎么念。

sentences.en: He doesn't even know how to say Rob.
sentences.zh: 他甚至不知道罗布该怎么念。

sentences.en: Oh, he doesn't know how to say the Rob part.
sentences.zh: 哦，他不知道“罗布”那部分怎么念。

sentences.en: Bennett Barberkow, that's easy to say.
sentences.zh: 班奈特·巴伯考，这个好念。

sentences.en: And Michael Terry, that's easy to say.
sentences.zh: 还有迈克尔·特里，这个也好念。
但全靠他们让这一切得以实现。
这帮家伙真他妈是好样的。

sentences.en: We wouldn't be here without them.
sentences.zh: 没有他们，我们今天也不会站在这里。

sentences.en: I want to see the socials line up in appreciation for Bennett, Rob, and Michael.
sentences.zh: 我想看到社交媒体上满是对贝内特、罗布和迈克尔的感谢与赞赏。

sentences.en: Truly, honestly, sincerely, thank you to anyone who has been spending some time with us
sentences.zh: 真心实意、诚恳地感谢所有花时间陪伴我们的人，

sentences.en: and letting us keep the lights on, as I think they say.
sentences.zh: 让我们能继续维持下去，就像他们常说的那样。

sentences.en: Yeah, and putting up with our nonsense and knowing that we're just here having fun, just
sentences.zh: 对，还有忍受我们的胡闹，知道我们和你们一样，
只是在这里找乐子，真的。

sentences.en: I'm so glad you guys don't have to pay for this.
sentences.zh: 我很庆幸你们不用为这个花钱。

sentences.en: But we can announce, right, Jason?
sentences.zh: 不过我们可以宣布了，对吧，杰森？

sentences.en: We can officially say that we are going to do a SmartList tour.
sentences.zh: 我们可以正式宣布我们要办一场 SmartList 巡演了。
你要去办 SmartList 巡演了。

sentences.en: We are going to six cities in North America.
sentences.zh: 我们要去北美六个城市。

sentences.en: And we have a ton to discuss.
sentences.zh: 而且我们有大把的事情要聊。

sentences.en: Dates, venues, even a special promo code for our listener.
sentences.zh: 日期、场地，甚至还有给我们听众的专属促销码。

sentences.en: But that's too much to make our guest wait for.
sentences.zh: 但这可不能让我们的嘉宾等太久。

sentences.en: So that's going to be at the end.
sentences.zh: 所以这些放到最后再说。

sentences.en: But right now, we've got to get to what might be our greatest of all time.
sentences.zh: 但现在，我们要请出可能是有史以来最棒的嘉宾。

sentences.en: So we have with us someone that would be best described as a true force.
sentences.zh: 所以今天做客我们节目的人，用真正的力量来形容他最贴切不过。

sentences.en: He's taken the gifts he's been given and the influence he holds and pointed them towards
sentences.zh: 他将天赋和影响力全部倾注于

sentences.en: a full menu of things that are truly too long to mention in an intro.
sentences.zh: 一系列多得在开场白里根本数不过来的成就上。

sentences.en: However, a couple to throw out there would be the creation of a world-class elementary
sentences.zh: 不过，随便挑两件来说，就包括创办了一所世界一流的小学

sentences.en: He's part owner, Will, of one of the world's most famous soccer teaMs.
sentences.zh: 威尔，他还是世界上最著名的足球队之一的联合所有者。

sentences.en: And he has starred in five filMs.
He's married to his high school sweetheart.
sentences.zh: 他和他的高中初恋结了婚。

sentences.en: He was recruited to play football by Notre Dame.
sentences.zh: 他曾被圣母大学招募去打美式橄榄球。

sentences.en: But instead, this fool took a gamble on basketball where he just can't seem to find any success.
sentences.zh: 但这个笨蛋偏偏去赌了一把篮球，结果好像怎么也混不出什么名堂。

sentences.en: Guys, please meet Mr. LeBron James.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，请欢迎勒布朗·詹姆斯先生。

sentences.en: That was a good intro right there, Jason.
sentences.zh: 杰森，这段开场白真不错。

sentences.en: You've never been introduced like that before, right?
sentences.zh: 你以前从来没听过这样的介绍吧？
大家对这事总是赞不绝口。

sentences.en: Jason, that was a good one.
But truly, let me tell you something.
sentences.zh: 但说真的，让我告诉你一件事。

sentences.en: LeBron, going through, and I don't do a lot of research, as the guys will atteSt.
sentences.zh: 勒布朗，我浏览了一下，正如大家所证实的，我其实不做太多调研。

sentences.en: I will go to a Wikipedia page, though.
sentences.zh: 不过我会去看维基百科页面。

sentences.en: Your page is more of a book.
sentences.zh: 你的页面更像是一本书。

sentences.en: And I just hit F it real quick.
I didn't know where to begin.
sentences.zh: 我都不知道该从哪里开始。

sentences.en: But truly, the stuff about philanthropy and family and all that stuff we're going to get into,
sentences.zh: 但说真的，关于慈善事业、家庭以及我们要深入探讨的那些内容，

sentences.en: because I think everyone else knows the other stuff.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得其他人都已经知道其他那些事了。

sentences.en: Will, you got something to say.
First of all, I was going to say, I just took off.
sentences.zh: 首先，我本来想说的是，我刚刚把衣服脱了。

sentences.en: I was wearing a Lakers T-shirt.
sentences.zh: 我刚才穿着一件湖人队的T恤。

sentences.en: I just took it off because I worked out.
sentences.zh: 我脱掉它只是因为我刚锻炼完。

sentences.en: And you don't want to get into my workout routine, LeBron, because it's pretty intense.
sentences.zh: 勒布朗，你肯定不想了解我的健身计划，因为实在是相当强度大。

sentences.en: I bet he'd love to hear it.
sentences.zh: 我敢说他一定很想听听。

sentences.en: I mean, well, these shoulders, you know they don't quit.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你看我这肩膀，你知道它们可从不偷懒。

sentences.en: I mean, I've tried to fire them, but they don't quit.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我曾想让它们歇会，但它们就是不肯停。

sentences.en: But what about the Liverpool element?
sentences.zh: 不过利物浦这部分是怎么回事？

sentences.en: That was a real shocker to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说真是个巨大的震惊。

sentences.en: That's, you know, I'm not a smart guy.
sentences.zh: 那就是，你知道的，我不是个聪明人。

sentences.en: But Will, did you know that?
sentences.zh: 但威尔，你知道那件事吗？

sentences.en: Will's a huge soccer fan, LeBron.
sentences.zh: 威尔是个超级足球迷，勒布朗。
我是利物浦的超级拥趸。

sentences.en: And I have been for a number of years.
sentences.zh: 而且我已经支持他们很多年了。

sentences.en: And I'm friendly with a bunch.
sentences.zh: 我和他们中的不少人都很熟。

sentences.en: But I had read that you were part owner, which is so crazy.
sentences.zh: 但我之前看到报道说你是联合老板，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Because I'm like, another thing that LeBron and I have in common.
sentences.zh: 因为我在想，我和勒布朗又多了一个共同点。

sentences.en: It's the shoulders and the soccer stuff.
sentences.zh: 就是肩膀和足球这些事。

sentences.en: LeBron, I have to say, this is especially exciting for me because I know who you are.
sentences.zh: 勒布朗，我必须得说，这对我来说格外令人兴奋，因为我知道你是谁。

sentences.en: We've had a few athletes on the show.
sentences.zh: 我们节目来过不少运动员。

sentences.en: And Sean just goes to, he starts playing Candy Crush.
sentences.zh: 然后肖就会直接开始玩糖果粉碎传奇。

sentences.en: And we pick it up after the guest goes away.
sentences.zh: 等嘉宾走了之后我们才继续录。

sentences.en: But I think he's engaged here.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得他这次挺投入的。
不，这绝对让人激动不已。

sentences.en: I have so many things I want to say to ask you that I've just thought about.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚想到了好多话想对你说、想问你。

sentences.en: One of the things is, you're such an incredible, Jason's right, you are a force.
sentences.zh: 其中有一点就是，你真的是个了不起的人，杰森说得对，你很有影响力。

sentences.en: And you've been such an incredible, you're so iconic already, which is crazy.
sentences.zh: 而且你一直是如此优秀，你现在就已经这么有传奇色彩了，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Because you're still a relatively young man, a lot younger than we are.
sentences.zh: 因为你还算是个年轻人，比我们要年轻得多。
我们都可以当他爸爸了。
我们都可以当他爸爸了。
但你已经成就了这么多了。

sentences.en: And it's so impressive to watch you do it.
sentences.zh: 看着你做到这一切，真的让人印象深刻。

sentences.en: And you do it with such, there's a grace about you.
sentences.zh: 而且你做这些事的时候，身上有一种风度。

sentences.en: Because part of the problem I think about being on top, and I wouldn't know,
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得，身处巅峰的困境之一在于——虽然我不会有这种体会——

sentences.en: but part of the problem is that you are subjected to a lot of slings and arrows from people from all sides.
sentences.zh: 但困境之一就是你要承受来自各方人群的各种冷枪暗箭。

sentences.en: Not the least of which is, I think every year since you got drafted, people are like, who's the greatest of all time?
sentences.zh: 最不用说的是，我觉得自从你被选秀选中以来，每年大家都在问：谁是历史最佳？

sentences.en: There's a poll every six hours.
sentences.zh: 每隔六个小时就会有一个民意调查。

sentences.en: ESPN will put it on their page.
sentences.zh: ESPN会把它发到自己的网页上。

sentences.en: And is LeBron greater than Michael Jordan?
sentences.zh: 勒布朗比迈克尔·乔丹更伟大吗？
这就好比，拜托，他是勒布朗。
那屁事肯定让人精疲力竭。
我的意思是，你刚才也这么说。

sentences.en: But, you know, I've always looked at it like any time you compared or you even mentioned with the greats that ever played this game, it's become humbling for me.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我一直觉得，每当你被拿来比较，或者甚至被跟这项运动历史上的那些伟大球星相提并论时，我都感到非常荣幸和谦卑。

sentences.en: Because, you know, the same people they put me in a category with or saying, compare this, compare this to that guy,
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，那些把我和他们归为一类的人，或者说“把这个跟那个家伙比一比”的人，

sentences.en: are the same guys that I looked up to for inspiration when I was growing up.
sentences.zh: 正是我在成长过程中仰望并寻求灵感的人。

sentences.en: And I needed that inspiration, you know, growing up in the inner city here in Akron of Ohio.
sentences.zh: 我当时确实需要那种灵感，你知道的，我是在俄亥俄州阿克伦的内城长大的。

sentences.en: So, you know, to have, you know, the Michael Jordan's and to have the, you know, the Kobe Bryant's, to have Ken Griffey Jr.'s and Deion Sanders,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，能有迈克尔·乔丹，能有科比·布莱恩特，能有小肯·格里菲和迪昂·桑德斯，

sentences.en: all those unbelievable sports figures, you know, when I needed it, you know, they helped me.
sentences.zh: 所有这些了不起的体育人物，你知道的，在我需要的时候，他们帮助了我。

sentences.en: So it's like, wow, you guys are comparing me to these greatest players that I've ever seen when I was growing up.
sentences.zh: 所以这就好像，哇，你们竟然把我和我小时候见过的这些最伟大的球员相提并论。

sentences.en: It's just like, it's such humbling, man.
sentences.zh: 这真的让人感到非常谦卑和荣幸，老兄。

sentences.en: Yeah, the stats will certainly put you in that category without even trying.
sentences.zh: 对啊，单凭数据就能把你归入那个类别，哪怕你根本不用刻意去争。

sentences.en: But what you've done off the court, the stuff you don't need to do, but you find yourself drawn to do.
sentences.zh: 但你在球场外所做的事情，那些你本来不必做，却发现自己情不自禁想要去做的事，

sentences.en: And as a result of your success on the court has given you access to do and the capital to do, I find really, really admirable.
sentences.zh: 以及你在球场上的成功赋予你的去做这件事的机会和资本，我都觉得非常非常令人钦佩。

sentences.en: But there's a drive, though, that has to fuel that because you're tired, I'll bet, doing the stuff that is your day job.
sentences.zh: 但要支撑这一点，肯定得有一种驱动力，因为我敢说，光是应付你的主业就已经让你够累的了。

sentences.en: Jason's tired for you right now, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，杰森现在替你觉得累了。

sentences.en: I'm sure you have a great infrastructure of people that can identify some charitable endeavors that are worthy of your time and the attention that you can put on them.
sentences.zh: 我确信你身边有一个很棒的团队，他们能帮你找出那些值得你花时间和精力的慈善事业。

sentences.en: I'm sure you rely on them a bit,
sentences.zh: 我确信你多多少少会依赖他们，

sentences.en: but a lot of that's got to be your own self-drive and to motivate those people to be diligent in how they assess certain charitable organizations and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 但其中很大一部分肯定还是得靠你自己的内驱力，去激励那些人在评估某些慈善组织及类似事务时保持严谨。

sentences.en: Where does that drive come from, that drive of philanthropy?
sentences.zh: 那种驱动力，那种对慈善事业的热情，究竟是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: No, you just – I mean, you said it, Jason.
sentences.zh: 不，你只是——我的意思是，你说的对，杰森。

sentences.en: I think for me, the drive comes from my upbringing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得对我来说，这种驱动力源于我的成长经历。

sentences.en: And, you know, growing up the way I grew up, you know, I'm a part of a single-parent household, just me and my mother, no siblings, you know, not much care.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我是在那样的环境中长大的，我来自一个单亲家庭，只有我和我母亲，没有兄弟姐妹，你知道的，也没什么奢求。

sentences.en: My mom worked on and off, you know, my whole childhood.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈在我整个童年时期一直断断续续地打零工。

sentences.en: So, you know, every day was kind of a struggle for us as a family.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，对我们这个家庭来说，每一天都有点像是在挣扎求生。

sentences.en: So I felt if I ever was even put into a position – this is also part of my inspiration, too.
sentences.zh: 因此我觉得，如果我有一天能处于某种位置——这也是我灵感的一部分。

sentences.en: Growing up, if I was ever put in a position where I could succeed at doing anything and I could make any kind of dollars, anything as far as capital,
sentences.zh: 在成长过程中，如果我有一天能处于那种做什么事都能成功、能赚到任何钱、拥有任何资本的位置上的话

sentences.en: that I want to give a lot of it back.
sentences.zh: 我想把其中的很大一部分回馈出去。

sentences.en: I want to give, you know, a lot of it back to my community because I understand what those kids are going through on a day-to-day basis.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道的，把很大一部分回馈给我的社区，因为我理解那些孩子们每天都在经历着什么。

sentences.en: It's because I've walked those same streets.
sentences.zh: 那是因为我走过同样的街道。

sentences.en: I know the hardships of what a single-parent household kid could feel like and the pressures and the adversity and all that stuff that comes with it.
sentences.zh: 我知道单亲家庭的孩子可能会感受到怎样的艰难，以及随之而来的压力、逆境和种种事情。
而且看到这种改变发生。

sentences.en: To see the change happen from your efforts has got to be unbelievably rewarding.
sentences.zh: 看到自己的努力带来改变，这一定非常有成就感。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, to hear some of the families, Sean, and like, Will, you know, you guys – I mean, just to see some of the families come and tell, you know, either, you know,
sentences.zh: 对啊，我是说，听到一些家庭，肖恩，还有威尔，你知道的，你们——我是说，只要看到一些家庭来告诉，你知道的，无论是，你知道的，

sentences.en: the faculty members that's at my school or the teachers that, you know, I've changed their lives.
sentences.zh: 我学校里的教职员工，或者老师们，你知道的，我改变了他们的生活。

sentences.en: Or tell my mother because now my mom is huge into the foundation and she welcomes a lot of it.
sentences.zh: 或者告诉我妈妈，因为现在我妈妈对基金会投入很大，她非常欢迎这一切。

sentences.en: Is she a part of it?
sentences.zh: 她也是其中的一部分吗？

sentences.en: She's like one of the head advisor boards of my foundation where I basically have an apartment complex here as well where I welcome a lot of the underprivileged families in.
sentences.zh: 她就像我基金会的核心顾问成员之一，基本上我在这里也有一栋公寓楼，我会在那里欢迎很多弱势家庭入住。

sentences.en: And we set them up with room and board, you know, that we're not in a position where they can, you know, afford their own living.
sentences.zh: 我们为他们安排食宿，你知道的，因为他们目前无力负担自己的生活。

sentences.en: So, you know, it's pretty cool.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，这真的很酷。

sentences.en: My mom welcomes all these families in.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈欢迎所有这些家庭入住。

sentences.en: So she's kind of like an ambassador, yeah?
sentences.zh: 所以她有点像个大使，对吧？

sentences.en: But you say, like, you came up – you know, you talk about your own childhood and to recognize, look,
sentences.zh: 但你说过，比如，你是如何成长起来的——你知道的，你谈到自己的童年，并意识到，看吧，

sentences.en: I really struggled and so I want to be able to give back and really do it in a way – in a really practical way.
sentences.zh: 我曾经真的很挣扎，所以我想能够回馈社会，并且以一种真正切实的方式去做到这一点。

sentences.en: A lot of people talk about it, but you actually do it and, you know, look at Sean.
sentences.zh: 很多人只是说说，但你真的去做了，而且，你看肖恩。

sentences.en: Sean grew up – you had a tougher, you know, childhood and stuff and you turned your back on your community.
sentences.zh: 肖恩是在——你的童年更艰难一些之类的事情，然后你背弃了你的社区。
你从没给任何人打过电话。
他把事情保持得很简单。

sentences.en: He lives in a mansion and he spends his money on watches.
sentences.zh: 他住在大豪宅里，把钱花在手表上。

sentences.en: And Jason doesn't know what the – you know, Jason jumped the line famously in line for the first iPhone.
sentences.zh: 而且杰森不知道——你知道的，杰森当年排队买第一代iPhone时可是出了名的插队。

sentences.en: So, like, we all have our own thing.
sentences.zh: 所以，你看，我们都有自己的一套。

sentences.en: My point is you could have gotten – you've had everything.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你本可以拥有——你已经拥有一切。
你取得了如此巨大的成功。

sentences.en: You could have just sailed away on a yacht and never looked back.
sentences.zh: 你本可以坐着游艇扬帆远航，再也不回头。

sentences.en: He's finding time to do that too, right?
sentences.zh: 他抽空也会去那样的，对吧？

sentences.en: We get some yacht hours each year, yes?
sentences.zh: 我们每年都有一些游艇时间，对吗？

sentences.en: We get some yacht – Jason, we get some yacht hours.
sentences.zh: 我们有一些游艇——杰森，我们有一些游艇时间。

sentences.en: Yeah, Ted, you've got to relax.
sentences.zh: 得了吧，特德，你得放松点。

sentences.en: Wait, have you been on a yacht with LeBron and you haven't told us about it?
sentences.zh: 等等，你跟勒布朗一起坐过游艇，而且你之前都没告诉我们？

sentences.en: But I know how to get to the Daily Mail, right?
sentences.zh: 但我知道怎么联系《每日邮报》，对吧？

sentences.en: You're hanging out and you're thinking, boy, if I can ever get this jump shot to really go down in a consistent way,
sentences.zh: 你到处闲逛，心里想，天哪，如果我能让这个急停跳投练得稳定一点的话，

sentences.en: I might be able to get myself to a place where I could either get out of here or stay here and help give back to this community.
sentences.zh: 我说不定能找到一个出路，要么离开这里，要么留在这里，回馈这个社区。

sentences.en: What was the moment when you thought to yourself, oh, you know what?
sentences.zh: 当时你是哪一刻突然心想，哦，你知道吗？

sentences.en: This is going to work and I think I've got a very realistic chance of making it.
sentences.zh: 这事儿有戏，而且我觉得我有很大可能真的能成功。

sentences.en: And now I'm starting to think about what I'm going to do if I do make it.
sentences.zh: 然后我开始琢磨，如果我真的成功了，我该做些什么。

sentences.en: Starting your plans about philanthropy and, you know, because a lot of kids fantasize in school.
sentences.zh: 开始筹划你的慈善事业，你知道的，因为很多小孩子在学校里都会瞎幻想。

sentences.en: When I'm older, I want to be a teacher so I don't have to do any of the schoolwork.
sentences.zh: 等我长大了，我要当老师，这样我就不用写作业了。

sentences.en: Like, what was that moment like and what were those first few plans?
sentences.zh: 那种感觉是怎样的？你最初的那些计划是什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, I feel like, yeah, the beginning of my junior year, I was 16 years old.
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得，对，在我高三刚开始的时候，我16岁。

sentences.en: So, it was right after my sophomore year in the summer going into my junior year.
sentences.zh: 所以，那是在高二暑假刚结束、迈入高三的时候。

sentences.en: I was on the cover of Sports Illustrated.
sentences.zh: 我登上了《体育画报》的封面。

sentences.en: They dubbed me the chosen one at 16 years old.
sentences.zh: 他们在我16岁的时候给我封了个“天选之子”的称号。

sentences.en: And the jinx of the cover on top of it all.
sentences.zh: 再加上这杂志封面自带的魔咒。

sentences.en: Right, and the jinx of the cover.
So, a lot of NBA execs were talking and they were saying that, you know, if I entered the draft, you know, right now I could be the number one pick.
sentences.zh: 所以，当时很多NBA高管都在讨论，他们说，你知道的，如果我当时参加选秀，我可能就是状元秀了。

sentences.en: And, you know, but, you know, doing all those things.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，但经历了那些事情之后。

sentences.en: So, I felt like I seen the success that I was having.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得自己看到了所取得的成功。

sentences.en: And the reason that I knew I wanted to come back and give back to my community is because I knew the success that I was having.
sentences.zh: 我之所以知道自己想要回来回馈社区，是因为我深知自己已经取得了成功。

sentences.en: Yes, it had to do with my God-given abilities and my talent and me putting in the work.
sentences.zh: 是的，这确实关乎上帝赋予我的能力、我的天赋以及我的努力付出。

sentences.en: But the support that I had from my coaches and my friends and my mom, they stayed on my ass every day.
sentences.zh: 但我的教练、朋友和妈妈给我的支持，他们天天都盯着我、鞭策我。

sentences.en: Like, listen, this is what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 就像是在说，听着，这就是我们要做的。

sentences.en: We all, listen, we have an opportunity to make this bigger than even what other people are saying.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人，听着，我们有机会把这件事搞得比别人想象的还要大。

sentences.en: Man, let's not fuck it up.
sentences.zh: 老兄，可别把事情搞砸了。

sentences.en: Like, that's all, you know, so, you know, it's tough on a 16-year-old because, listen, me and my friends, we want to do, you know, first year driving.
sentences.zh: 差不多就是这样，所以，你知道的，这对一个16岁的孩子来说挺艰难的，因为，听着，我和我的朋友们，我们想去体验，你知道的，刚满法定驾龄的那种感觉。

sentences.en: We want to go to house parties.
sentences.zh: 我们想去参加家庭派对。

sentences.en: We want to go, you know, hang with the other high school kids and do kid things.
sentences.zh: 我们想去，你知道的，跟其他高中生一起厮混，做一些小孩子做的事。

sentences.en: But, you know, we can't do it.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我们不能去。

sentences.en: Yeah, Jason knows about the kid things, right?
sentences.zh: 没错，杰森懂得小孩子的事，对吧？

sentences.en: Like driving off the Warner Brothers lot when you're 16 in a Porsche.
sentences.zh: 比如16岁时开着保时捷离开华纳兄弟制片厂。

sentences.en: But with your, LeBron, with your kids, your own kids,
sentences.zh: 但是勒布朗，对于你的孩子们，你自己的孩子们，

sentences.en: what an incredible story you have to pass down to them about your struggle and then how you turn it around and how you're giving back.
sentences.zh: 你有一段多么不可思议的故事可以传给他们，关于你的奋斗，你是如何扭转局面的，以及你现在是如何回馈社会的。

sentences.en: Is it something that they get?
And if they don't get it, do you grind it in their brains?
sentences.zh: 如果他们理解不了，你会天天在他们脑子里灌输吗？

sentences.en: It's like, you've got to keep looking at me.
sentences.zh: 就像是，你们得一直看着我。

sentences.en: You've got to keep looking at my story.
sentences.zh: 你们得一直看着我的故事。

sentences.en: You have got to learn how to give back.
sentences.zh: 你们必须学会如何回馈社会。

sentences.en: I mean, it's so cool to have a dad that does all that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，能有一个做成这一切的父亲，真的很酷。

sentences.en: There's absolutely nothing I can do, nothing I can do to give them the same moment or aspirations or, like, drive that I had.
sentences.zh: 我完全无能为力，我没有办法给他们和我当年一样的时刻、抱负或者那种拼劲。
雄心壮志是教不出来的。

sentences.en: I grew up in Akron, Ohio in the inner city, you know, and the hood is what we call it, the projects.
sentences.zh: 我是在俄亥俄州阿克伦市内城长大的，你知道的，也就是我们叫的贫民窟、保障房。

sentences.en: And my kids are growing up four years in Miami on South Beach and now going on five years in Brentwood.
sentences.zh: 而我的孩子们在迈阿密南海滩度过了四年，现在又在布伦特伍德快要满五年了。

sentences.en: So, you know, and when we were here for those four-year run, when I was in Cleveland, they were younger.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，当我们在克利夫兰待的那四年里，他们还小。

sentences.en: You know, we're now in the suburbs.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们现在住在郊区。

sentences.en: So I went to public schools and challenging public schools until I got to high school because of my basketball ability.
sentences.zh: 所以我上的是公立学校，而且是很有挑战性的公立学校，直到我因为篮球特长才上了高中。

sentences.en: But these kids are growing up in private schools.
sentences.zh: 但这些孩子们是在私立学校里长大的。

sentences.en: So the one thing that I can do is instill the morals and what we do in this house.
sentences.zh: 所以我能做的一件事，就是灌输道德观念以及我们这个家一向的行事方式。

sentences.en: And this is how you need to represent yourself when you leave the house.
sentences.zh: 这就是你离开家时应该展现自我的方式。

sentences.en: As a young man, I got two boys, two teenage boys.
sentences.zh: 作为年轻人，我有两个男孩，两个十几岁的男孩。

sentences.en: I got a daughter that's seven years old.
sentences.zh: 我还有一个七岁的女儿。

sentences.en: So you give them the blueprint and then you got to let them, you know, I hope that they have some adversity.
sentences.zh: 所以你给他们指明方向，然后你不得不让他们去，你知道的，我希望他们能经历一些逆境。

sentences.en: You know, they need some hardships.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们需要一些艰难困苦。

sentences.en: I hope they find some along this way because you really only know who you are and you're only going to be able to come back from situations because the best teacher in life is experience.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们在这一路上能遇到一些，因为你真的只有在经历过后才会真正了解自己，也只有这样你才能从困境中走出来，因为生活中最好的老师就是经验。

sentences.en: And I bet you lean on mom a lot too, right?
sentences.zh: 我敢说你也很依赖妈妈吧，对吗？

sentences.en: I bet your wife is incredibly important to, with all the time you're spending on the road.
sentences.zh: 我敢说考虑到你花在路上的所有时间，你的妻子一定极其重要。

sentences.en: I mean, the three of us know as well, the amount of time you spend away from home is immense and you really have to lean on your partner.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们三个都很清楚，你离家的时间是极多的，你真的必须依靠你的伴侣。

sentences.en: Like my wife is a part-time dad too, you know?
sentences.zh: 就像我妻子其实也是个兼职爸爸，你知道吗？

sentences.en: They're literally the boss of the household.
sentences.zh: 她们简直就是家里的一把手。

sentences.en: We all know that, that it's hard for us to come home and be like, okay, this is the hell we're doing.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道这一点，我们很难回到家里说，好吧，这就是我们要搞的。

sentences.en: And like, dad, you've been gone for four or five months straight.
sentences.zh: 然后就像是，爸爸，你已经连续离开四五个月了。

sentences.en: Like mom already told us, go sit down, dad, and keep your feet up.
sentences.zh: 就像妈妈已经告诉我们的，坐下吧，爸爸，把脚翘起来歇会儿。

sentences.en: I mean, listen, it sounds like your kids are going to have a little bit of adversity with that sunset traffic coming out of Brentwood, getting over the 405.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，听着，听起来你的孩子们要面对的一点逆境，就是从布伦特伍德出来汇入405号公路的夕阳西下时的交通堵塞。

sentences.en: The crawl to Barrington is just too much.
sentences.zh: 那段开往巴灵顿的龟速车程实在太折磨人了。

sentences.en: And now back to the show.
sentences.zh: 现在言归正传，回到节目中。

sentences.en: You know, you do all this stuff and you've got this school where you provide opportunities.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你做了所有这些事情，你还建了这所学校来提供机会。

sentences.en: I mean, Jason brought it up.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，杰森提到了这一点。

sentences.en: I love the way, by the way, as you were talking about growing up, you kept saying we, you know, that the people who are around you are saying we have an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我很喜欢这一点，当你在谈论成长经历时，你一直在说“我们”，你知道的，你身边的人都在说“我们有机会”。

sentences.en: You know, we got to keep going.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们得继续前进。

sentences.en: We got to keep doing the things the way that you were part of something and that you relied, like as you talked about, these people that you leaned on.
sentences.zh: 我们得继续用那种方式做事，让你成为某群体的一部分，并且你有所依赖，正如你所谈到的，这些人是你所依靠的。

sentences.en: And I love that you talked about it in that, we, I think it's so important to sort of, to have that kind of support system.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢你用这种“我们”的方式来谈论它，我认为拥有那种支持系统是如此重要。

sentences.en: But as you talk to kids who don't have the jump shot that you had, as you, what do you say to those kids who are like, look, man, I hit the lottery.
sentences.zh: 但是，当你对那些没有你那种跳投天赋的孩子们说话时，当你，你对那些觉得“听着，老兄，我中了彩票”的孩子们说些什么呢？

sentences.en: I had a tremendous amount of skill.
I had great people around me.
I had God-given gifts and I had the willpower to do it.
sentences.zh: 我拥有天赋予予的天赋，并且我有意志力去做到这一点。
那是天时地利人和的完美风暴。

sentences.en: That's not going to be the experience for 99.9% of the kids.
sentences.zh: 99.9% 的孩子都不会经历那种情况。

sentences.en: That's the one thing that we have, like at my school here, we don't, we don't even have a basketball complex at my school, you know, but we have, we have an art,
sentences.zh: 那是我们所拥有的唯一东西，比如在我这里的学校，我们没有，我们学校甚至连一个篮球综合馆都没有，你知道，但我们有，我们有一个艺术，

sentences.en: we have an art room, we have a music lab, we have a technology lab, we have computers.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个美术室，一个音乐实验室，一个科技实验室，还有电脑。

sentences.en: Like, so, like, we're, we're, we're all, every single day asking our kids, what do you want to do?
sentences.zh: 所以，每天我们都在问孩子们，你们想做什么？

sentences.en: You know, a lot of them say sports, but a lot of them like, listen, I want to be a doctor, you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们很多人说想搞体育，但也有很多人说，听着，我想当一名医生，你知道吗？

sentences.en: So we have doctors that come in and talk to our kids.
sentences.zh: 所以我们请来医生和我们的孩子们交流。

sentences.en: A lot of them say, okay, I want to be a cop.
sentences.zh: 很多人说，好吧，我想当个警察。

sentences.en: You know, we got cops, you know, obviously at the front door when they walk in, it's so kind to our kids and they can talk to them and give them guidance.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当他们走进正门时，我们显然有警察，他们对我们的孩子们非常友好，孩子们可以跟他们交谈并获得指导。

sentences.en: Like, what do you want to be?
sentences.zh: 比如，你想成为什么样的人？

sentences.en: Like, what do you want to be?
You might not even know what your aspirations are right now, but you do have dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 你现在可能还不知道自己的抱负是什么，但你确实有梦想。

sentences.en: We all had dreams about what we wanted to be.
sentences.zh: 我们都曾对自己想成为什么样的人有过梦想。

sentences.en: So, you know, if it's something that they have passion about, we try to bring it to the school and try to give them the resources to, you know, let's,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，如果这是他们充满热情的事情，我们会尽量把它带到学校，并努力为他们提供资源，你知道，让我们，

sentences.en: let's see if we can tap into it.
sentences.zh: 让我们看看能不能激发这方面的潜能。

sentences.en: And we might, you might fail that first one, you know, let's, let's try it again.
sentences.zh: 而且我们可能会，你第一次可能会失败，你知道，没关系，我们再试一次。

sentences.en: Or you might say, I don't, let's try something else.
sentences.zh: 或者你可能会说，我不，让我们尝试点别的。

sentences.en: You know, that's all about being a kid.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就是当孩子的意义所在。

sentences.en: You try so many things until you finally figure out, okay, oh, this is what I want to do.
sentences.zh: 你尝试了那么多事情，直到你最终弄明白，好吧，哦，这就是我想做的事。

sentences.en: And then let's try to give them the resources.
sentences.zh: 然后让我们试着为他们提供资源。
这就是，这就是我的全部想法。

sentences.en: I want to just give them the resources to be able to tap into whatever they want to do.
sentences.zh: 我只想为他们提供资源，让他们能够去发掘任何他们想做的事情。

sentences.en: And now I want to get, I want to ask you stuff about playing in the game because, you know, I played basketball when I was a kid and I was like, I'd be like, no, I did.
sentences.zh: 现在我想，我想问你一些关于打比赛的事情，因为，你知道，我小时候也打过篮球，而且我当时就想，我会说，不，我真的打过。

sentences.en: But, and, and I was like, when everybody, when, when the ball would be rebounded, here we go.
sentences.zh: 但是，然后，我当时就想，当每个人，当，当球被抢到篮板时，这就开始了。

sentences.en: When you did, when you're talking, when you're saying to LeBron, you're describing playing basketball to LeBron James.
sentences.zh: 当你在做，当你说话时，当你在对勒布朗说时，你是在向勒布朗·詹姆斯描述打篮球的过程。

sentences.en: So when I was a kid, I played.
sentences.zh: 所以当我还是个孩子的时候，我打过球。

sentences.en: Tell me about your experience playing basketball.
sentences.zh: 跟我谈谈你打篮球的经历吧。

sentences.en: I played basketball and whenever there was a rebound and everybody would run to the end of the other opposite end of the court, I'd go, go, no, you guys go.
sentences.zh: 我打过篮球，每当有篮板球而且每个人都跑到球场的另一端时，我就会说，去吧，不，你们去吧。
这叫做偷懒等机会（偷分）。

sentences.en: I'm, I'm, I'm just going to take a beat, but I'm right behind you guys.
sentences.zh: 我，我，我只是想喘口气，但我真的紧跟在你们后面。

sentences.en: But wait, but here's the thing.
But I look at you, because I've been to a couple of Lakers game live courts.
sentences.zh: 但我看着你，因为我去现场看过好几场湖人队的比赛。

sentences.en: I was lucky enough to have courtside seats.
sentences.zh: 我很幸运能坐在场边座位。

sentences.en: And seeing you, I have to say, seeing, seeing, seeing you play live and seeing the whole team play live is so much more thrilling than TV, but TV's thrilling too.
sentences.zh: 看到你，我不得不说，看，看，看你现场打球和看整个团队现场打球比在电视上要刺激得多，不过电视转播也很刺激。

sentences.en: But to see it live, it's just unbelievably exciting.
sentences.zh: 但是亲眼看到，真的是难以置信地激动人心的。

sentences.en: And, and I don't, I couldn't even possibly begin to understand how you do what you do.
sentences.zh: 而且，而且我，我甚至根本无法开始去理解你是怎么做成你所做的事情的。

sentences.en: When you're running down, I mean, it seems like it's endless.
sentences.zh: 当你们在往下跑的时候，我的意思是，感觉就像是无止境的。

sentences.en: It's just an endless amount of energy.
sentences.zh: 那就是用之不竭的精力。

sentences.en: Do the parents take turns bringing oranges for halftime?
sentences.zh: 家长们会轮流在半场休息时带橙子来吗？

sentences.en: Sean's going to ask a question.

sentences.en: And, you know, we are in a good place today.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们现在状态很好。

sentences.zh: 但我们想要继续攀登，因为，你知道的，我们想要继续建设，建立人际关系，并为每个人创作出色的内容。

sentences.en: And you get to do with the people.
